typography.pairing_strategy: Radical weight contrast. Loud uppercase headings in Clash Display mixed with extremely clean Manrope for body text.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[7vw] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter uppercase

secondary.name: Charcoal Black
secondary.usage: Primary text, dark mode sections, stark borders.

accent_1.name: Urgent Red
accent_1.usage: CTAs, hover states, highlight text, warning.

visual_enhancers: Noise/Grain texture overlay across the entire site (pointer-events-none, opacity 5%).
1px stark black borders around sections and grid items (Brutalist touch).
High-contrast, inverse-color hover states for buttons.
Clipped frames: Product photography should have sharp square or slightly imperfect borders. Never soft rounded corners.
Editorial numbers (01, 02, 03) in massive typography for manifesto chapters.

motion.scroll: Lenis momentum scrolling is mandatory for premium feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal. Text lines start translated down out of a hidden overflow container, and animate up into view sequentially.
motion.marquee: One slow, continuous editorial marquee using framer-motion or react-fast-marquee, showing key campaigns.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero images and large typography on scroll.

components.name: Kinetic Hero
components.instructions: Use framer-motion to orchestrate a line-by-line staggered reveal of the loud headline. Overlay a documentary-style image with slight parallax on scroll.

components.name: Manifesto Chapters
components.instructions: Asymmetrical layout. Large numerals (e.g., '01') paired with raw, unapologetic text. Use framer-motion's whileInView to fade and slide up.

components.name: Programs Grid
components.instructions: Bento grid (Tetris style). Wide gaps, varying spans. Include clipped documentary images.

components.name: AI Chatbot Widget
components.instructions: A floating action button that opens a chat panel. Uses shadcn's sheet or popover. Styled to look like a raw, stark command interface.

components.name: Admin Dashboard
components.instructions: Use shadcn/ui components extensively. Keep it clean, high-density grid, functional (Swiss archetype). Sharp edges, no soft shadows.

layouts.public_site: Asymmetrical, large typography, generous padding (py-24, py-32), stark dividers between sections.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation, top header, dense grid layout for stats and tables.

image_urls.description: Authentic portrait of an Indian girl in red and yellow shirt, documentary style.
Activist woman holding a drawing for justice, represents loud voice and women empowerment.
Group of Indian children smiling and waving, perfect for education program highlights.
Rural Indian women sitting in a circle during a community meeting.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. White text on Urgent Red, Black text on Off-White.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap complex framer-motion animations with useReducedMotion hooks to disable them if preferred by the user.
accessibility.aria_labels: All forms, inputs, and interactive widgets (including the AI chatbot) must have proper aria-labels and roles.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Clash Display' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts or standard imports. If Clash Display is unavailable, use 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Anton'.
Build the public site without Shadcn layout wrappers (pure Tailwind). Use Shadcn ONLY for interactive logic (Forms, Modals, Chatbot UI).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling in a global App wrapper.
For the admin dashboard, strictly use Shadcn components to build a dense, highly functional layout.
Make the site loud, unapologetic, and editorial. Do NOT center text blocks globally. Rely on stark left alignments and asymmetrical spacing.
Create dummy API routes in FastAPI to handle contact form and volunteer registration submissions, storing them in MongoDB.
Implement the Chatbot UI seamlessly, matching the dark/stark aesthetic of the brand, integrating with the mock FastAPI endpoint.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep borders sharp for this brutalist/editorial theme.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, selection states.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Include data-testid attributes for all key interactive elements.
Use Sonner for all toast notifications.
